title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Fri 20 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 09:00 to about 16:30. Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 4,900 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 5,400 ft by the Kekoa camera, 500 ft higher than yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 4,900 ft, off by 500 ft; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,700 ft, off by 700 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest south about 13:07, crossing Kula Highway at the middle Lower Kula Road junction. Data gaps: no readings all day from 1 station (Nakula); the Mesonet could not be reached on 34 of 59 updates.
